description_en: Queries vulnerabilities detected by scans under the current Alibaba Cloud account by using paged query with paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下扫描检出的漏洞
name: ListVulnerabilities

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query with paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Settings for paged query with paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The patch IDs used for filtering. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 按补丁包ID过滤，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: update_ids

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the user endpoint device. Exact match. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): lists user endpoint devices
parameters.help_zh:
用户终端设备的唯一标识，精确匹配。长度不超过64个字符。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: dev_tag

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type of the user endpoint device. Valid values:
windows: Windows. Currently, vulnerability scanning supports only Windows
parameters.help_zh:
用户终端设备的操作系统类型。取值：
windows：Windows系统。当前漏洞扫描仅支持Windows系统
parameters.name: dev_type

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the user endpoint device. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户终端设备的主机名，支持模糊查询。长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: hostname

parameters.help_en:
The user ID. Exact match. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): lists user endpoint devices.
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): queries the details of a user endpoint device
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，精确匹配。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses
parameters.help_zh: 用户名，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、星号（*）、连字符（-）、@、空格、中间点（·）、圆括号
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The department name. Matches any level of department in the organizational structure to which the user belongs. Specify the department name itself without the full path of the organizational structure
parameters.help_zh: 部门名称，匹配用户所属组织架构中的任一层级部门。填写部门名称本身，不需要填写组织架构的完整路径
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vulnerability scanning node that detected the vulnerability. Used to filter detection results of a specified node. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListVulScanTasks](~~ListVulScanTasks~~): lists vulnerability scanning nodes.
[CreateVulScanTask](~~CreateVulScanTask~~): creates a vulnerability scanning node
parameters.help_zh:
检出该漏洞的漏洞扫描任务ID，用于筛选指定任务的检出结果。取值来源：
[ListVulScanTasks](~~ListVulScanTasks~~)：批量查询漏洞扫描任务。
[CreateVulScanTask](~~CreateVulScanTask~~)：创建漏洞扫描任务
parameters.name: scan_task_id

parameters.help_en: The vulnerability title. Fuzzy match is supported. Matches both Chinese and English titles
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞标题，支持模糊查询。同时匹配中文标题与英文标题
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability risk level used for filtering. Valid values:
High: high risk.
Mid: medium risk.
Low: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
按漏洞风险等级过滤。取值：
High：高危。
Mid：中危。
Low：低危
parameters.name: vul_level

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability type used for filtering. Valid values:
windows: Windows system vulnerability.
ai_agent: AI Agent vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
按漏洞类型过滤。取值：
windows：Windows系统漏洞。
ai_agent：AI Agent漏洞
parameters.name: vul_type
